summary_ja: スロッティング・クライテリアを用いる特定貸付債権の格付付与と、第百二十九条の表の区分への紐付けを定める。
summary_en: Requires specialized lending exposures under the slotting criteria to be rated under compliant rating systems and mapped to the categories in the tables of Article 129.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach uses slotting criteria for specialized lending exposures, it shall assign ratings to those specialized lending exposures based on the criteria, rating scale and procedures of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company that conform to the minimum requirements prescribed in this Section.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall map the ratings referred to in the preceding paragraph to the categories prescribed in the tables in Article 129, paragraphs (4) and (6).
